reviews.title: Advertised free trial, charged for a year
reviews.text: I was excited to try this app because it seemed fun and useful. I signed up expecting the 7-day trial, but was charged for the full annual subscription immediately. I canceled within 10 seconds of seeing the charge. I’ve also emailed support twice and received no response. Very upsetting experience, especially when I was genuinely interested in using the app.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Not as advertised.  Not to mention, I clicked on 7 day free trial and was charged for 2 months. Don’t to be fooled into clicking on this.
